title: Apply the reviewed Vault bootstrap prepare infrastructure
expected_outcome: The reviewed Vault prepare runner resources exist privately, with no cluster-admin policy association and without executing the runner or deploying Vault.
constraints: Use AWS_PROFILE=node-operator-t2 and the recorded remediation commit only.

The only IAM mutation is to add eks:CreateAccessEntry on the node-operator cluster, codebuild:CreateProject on the Vault bootstrap project, and iam:PassRole for the Vault bootstrap role conditioned on codebuild.amazonaws.com.
Immediately before apply, regenerate a refresh-backed plan and require only the two remaining creates, zero changes, and zero deletes.
Set Vault runner=true and Vault cluster-admin=false; preserve Argo CD bootstrap runner=true/admin=false.
Apply only the reviewed saved plan.
Do not start CodeBuild, Helm, kubectl, Vault, secret access, cluster-admin association, public-network change, merge, or publication.

external_actions: assume the existing NodeOperatorTerraformApply role through the configured profile
update the existing NodeOperatorT2ScopedApply policy solely with the three approved IAM actions
read-only plan refresh and ECR verification
apply the exact reviewed Terraform saved plan only when it has the recorded 2-create/0-change/0-delete allowlist
prohibited_actions: Terraform apply outside the approved saved plan
any IAM action other than the three exact approved additions

primary_owner.responsibility: plan gate, apply scope, security boundary, and final sign-off

delegations.escalation_trigger: evidence implies deployment or secret access

validation: post-apply read-only resource and EKS policy checks
